decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's established consumer health knowledge and pharmacy channels, so the firm can read market feedback and keep refining the line even though it has not been visible on the website recently.
The skin and hair supplement sits close to the firm's existing supplement expertise and pharmacy relationships, which lets management interpret its performance and adjust it rather than withdraw it.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche concept with low visibility and no recent observations, but it still fits the firm's supplement know-how, so it stays on the market for now under closer review.

The OTC triptan is further from the firm's core offer, but it draws on the firm's own pharmaceutical R&D, regulatory and manufacturing capabilities, and its 2019 page of its own signals commitment, so the firm keeps it while it builds knowledge of this new OTC switch segment.
